remarks: Welcome to this sun filled, move in ready Cape that perfectly blends coastal charm w/ modern comfort. Nestled in one of Stamford's desirable waterfront neighborhoods, this home offers the ideal balance of beachside tranquility and city convenience, just moments from Holly Pond and Cove Island Park. Step inside to a bright open concept living and dining area featuring hardwood floors, a wood-burning fireplace, & French doors that lead to your private outdoor oasis. The backyard is an entertainer's dream with a Trex-style deck + patio, & lush landscaping that create the perfect setting for summer gatherings. The fully fenced yard offers privacy along w/ a detached garage & shed for added storage. Back inside, the main level features a tasteful eat-in kitchen, a spacious main level bedroom, beautifully renovated full bath, & convenient laundry/mudroom. Upstairs are two additional bedrooms with hardwood floors & access to storage in the eaves. This home has been thoughtfully maintained with a newer deck and patio, updated bath, newer dishwasher and washer, and efficient two-zone heating. Enjoy the ultimate coastal lifestyle - take a morning stroll to Cove Beach, drop your kayak into Holly Pond, chase the icecream truck down the street, or spend your weekends playing tennis, volleyball, or simply relaxing by the Sound. Just minutes to downtown Stamford, Metro North, and I-95, this rare gem invites you to unpack, unwind, and start living the beach lifestyle you've always dreamed of
